fields.description: Automatic series for the application number.
fields.label: Series

fields.description: Who is applying. Their name and contact details live on the Red Profile.
fields.label: Red Profile

fields.description: When the application was made.
fields.label: Applied On

fields.description: Who this applicant is, read from their Red Profile. Correcting the profile corrects this card.
fields.label: Applicant Identity

fields.description: The branch this person will serve with, and where the application routes for approval. Not where they live.
fields.label: Serving Branch

fields.description: The volunteer record this application became. Empty until it is approved.
fields.label: Volunteer

fields.description: What this applicant says they can do. Copied to their volunteer record at acceptance; this copy stays as they declared it.
fields.label: Skills

fields.description: Languages this applicant speaks. Copied to their volunteer record at acceptance.
fields.label: Languages Spoken

fields.description: When this applicant says they can serve. Copied to their volunteer record at acceptance.
fields.label: Availability

fields.description: Why this applicant wants to volunteer. Kept on the application only, as what they said at the time.
fields.label: Motivation

fields.description: Relevant experience the applicant offers, in their own words. Not a record of any qualification.
fields.label: Prior Experience

fields.description: Applicant details from the public registration form. Copied to the person's Red Profile and cleared on save.
fields.label: Registration Intake

fields.description: Given name from the public registration form. Copied to the applicant's Red Profile and cleared on save.
fields.label: Applicant First Name

fields.description: Family name from the public registration form. Copied to the applicant's Red Profile and cleared on save.
fields.label: Applicant Last Name

fields.description: Telephone number from the public registration form. Copied to the applicant's Red Profile and cleared on save.
fields.label: Applicant Phone

fields.description: Gender from the public registration form. Copied to the applicant's Red Profile and cleared on save.
fields.label: Applicant Gender

fields.description: Date of birth from the public registration form. Copied to the applicant's Red Profile and cleared on save.
fields.label: Applicant Date of Birth

fields.description: Answers to the extra questions this organization asks, with the wording used at the time.
fields.label: Answers

fields.description: Who to call if something happens to this person while they are volunteering. At least one contact the applicant has permitted us to call is needed before the application can be approved.
fields.label: Emergency Contacts

fields.description: Worked out from the applicant's date of birth and the age this society counts as adult. Not typed, and re-derived on every save.
fields.label: Applicant Is a Minor

fields.description: A parent or guardian's permission, and the reviewer's check of it. A minor's application cannot be approved until a consent here is both given and verified.
fields.label: Guardian Consent

fields.description: What this applicant agreed to, in the wording that stood on the day they agreed to it.
fields.label: Declarations

fields.description: Where the approval stands. Set by the approval engine.
fields.label: Approval State
fields.options:
Draft
Submitted
In Review
Approved
Rejected
Withdrawn
Expired

fields.description: The approval stage under review. Set by the approval engine.
fields.label: Approval Stage

fields.description: When the current approval stage was entered. Used to measure how long a decision is taking.
fields.label: Stage Entered On

fields.description: Who decided what, when and why. Written by the approval engine.
fields.label: Approval Decisions
